description: RS3 launched with HTML5 and new UI.
Bonds added to RS3 for gold-to-membership.
Legacy Mode released for pre-EoC combat.
Ironman Mode added to RS3 and OSRS.
Mod Jed fired over security breach.
Login lockout hits thousands of RS3 players.
Duel Arena removed, replaced by Het's Oasis.
Sailing chosen as new OSRS skill.
Hero Pass nerfed after community outcry.
Jagex Accounts rolled out to all players.
Mod Pips resigns as Jagex CEO.
Pride events canceled by new CEO.
Jagex reverses Pride decision after backlash.
Nex: Angel of Death and T92 magic weapons released.
Luck rework and new rare drop tiers introduced.
Ranch Out of Time & 120 Farming/Herblore unlocked.
Yak Track launched and 120 skill cap increases added.
Zuk boss and new cape upgrade released.
Membership and Shop price changes announced.
GE Tax and Reduced Death Costs implemented.
Cursed Energies removed; Animate Dead and FSOA nerfed.
New Wilderness Special Flash Event released.
Um achievements released; Tome of Um renamed.
Sanctum of Rebirth and T95-T100 magic upgrades released.
Mining & Smithing expanded to level 110; T100 gear released.
Player Value Survey update hints at MTX reform/removal.
Old School runescape released for mobile
